segments.title: Phasmophobia Gameplay Session
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts a multiplayer Phasmophobia ghost-hunting session with guests Fiona and Bry across multiple haunted maps, identifying ghost types (Oni, Spirit) and managing sanity mechanics before transitioning to Patreon podcast.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors a Phasmophobia gameplay stream with guests, struggles with audio settings and sanity mechanics, mentions beating Spider-Man 2 and considering Lethal Company later.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell is level 3 in Phasmophobia progression.
Case Blackwell considers playing Lethal Company after the Patreon podcast.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell departs the news desk for a full-session Phasmophobia stream, teaming with Fiona and Bry to investigate haunted houses, identify ghost types including an Oni and a Spirit, and manage sanity mechanics across multiple rounds. The broadcast concludes with Case transitioning to a Patreon podcast and raiding Avali.
